rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 2027〜2028年に、AWSの世界のインフラへNVIDIAのGPUを追加で200万基導入する計画
relations.text_en: AWS and NVIDIA plan to deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs across AWS global infrastructure in 2027-2028

source.label: Amazon ニュース
source.quote: the companies plan to deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs across AWS’s global infrastructure

relations.text: NVIDIAにとってAmazonは、AI計算機能を自社基盤に組み込む競合企業の1社だ
relations.text_en: Amazon is one of the companies that incorporate AI computing hardware in their own platforms and compete with NVIDIA

source.label: NVIDIA 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: such as Alibaba Group, Alphabet Inc., Amazon, Inc., or Amazon, Baidu, Inc., Huawei, and Microsoft Corporation, or Microsoft

relations.text: AWSとの戦略的関係を、5年・複数世代の契約で拡大
relations.text_en: Expanded the strategic relationship with AWS through a five-year, multi-generational agreement

source.label: Marvell 8-K(2024年12月)
source.quote: the expansion of their strategic relationship with Amazon Web Services (AWS) through a five-year, multi-generational agreement that includes collaboration across multiple AWS products and the use of AWS cloud infrastructure
source.note: 記載にTrainiumの名前は出てきません。
source.note_en: The source does not mention Trainium by name.

relations.text: AWS向けにIntel 18Aでカスタム AIファブリックチップ、Intel 3でカスタムXeon 6を製造する複数年契約
relations.text_en: Will make a custom AI fabric chip on Intel 18A and a custom Xeon 6 on Intel 3 for AWS

source.label: Intel の発表
source.quote: Intel will produce an AI fabric chip for AWS on Intel 18A, the company’s most advanced process node. Intel will also produce a custom Xeon 6 chip on Intel 3, building on the existing partnership under which Intel produces Xeon Scalable processors for AWS.

relations.text: 2018年からAWSと協業し、AMD EPYCベースのEC2インスタンスを100種類以上提供
relations.text_en: Has worked with AWS since 2018 and provides more than 100 EPYC-based EC2 instances

source.label: AMD の発表
source.quote: AMD began working with AWS in 2018 and now provides more than 100 EPYC processor-based instances for general purpose, compute optimized, memory optimized and high performance computing workloads.

relations.text: Amazonと共同で設計・開発した商用バン
relations.text_en: Designed and engineered the Rivian Commercial Van in collaboration with Amazon

source.label: Rivian 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: designed and engineered by Rivian in collaboration with Amazon.com, Inc. and its affiliates (collectively, “Amazon”), our first commercial customer

relations.text: Amazonが新株予約権と株式でRivianの議決権の12.7%を保有
relations.text_en: Amazon holds Rivian equity via a warrant and shares, 12.7% of voting power at December 31, 2025

source.label: Rivian 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC, which beneficially owns shares of our capital stock (including s hares issuable upon the exercise of a warrant to purchase 3,723,050 shares of Class A common stock, as amended) representing 12.7% of our voting power as of December 31, 2025

relations.text: 2042年まで、1,920MWの原子力電力をAmazonへ供給する拡大版の電力購入契約
relations.text_en: Talen agreed to supply Amazon with 1,920MW of carbon-free nuclear power through 2042 under an expanded PPA

source.label: Talen Energy 8-K Ex. 99.1
source.quote: Talen will provide Amazon with 1,920 megawatts of carbon-free nuclear power through 2042, with options to further extend its duration.
source.note: 全量の供給は2032年までの見込みです。
source.note_en: Full volume expected no later than 2032.

relations.text: Comanche Peak原子力発電所から1,200MWを供給する20年の電力購入契約
relations.text_en: 20-year PPA with AWS to supply 1,200MW from the Comanche Peak nuclear plant

source.label: Vistra 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: pursuant to which we have agreed to supply to AWS 1,200 MW of carbon-free power from the Comanche Peak Nuclear Power Plant.
source.note: 供給開始は2027年第4四半期の見込みです。
source.note_en: Delivery expected to begin in Q4 2027.

relations.text: Entergy Mississippiが、データセンター向けの大口の電力供給契約を締結
relations.text_en: Entergy Mississippi executed large customer supply and service agreements to serve data center campuses

source.label: Entergy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Entergy Mississippi executed a large customer supply and service agreement to serve two data center campuses located in Madison County, Mississippi in which Amazon Web Services is investing.

relations.text: AWSの技術(TrainiumやGravitonなど)に10年で1,000億ドル超を支出すると約束
relations.text_en: Committed to spend more than $100B over ten years on AWS technologies including Trainium and Graviton

source.label: Anthropic の発表
source.quote: We are committing more than $100 billion over the next ten years to AWS technologies, securing up to 5GW of new capacity to train and run Claude.

relations.text: Amazonが今回50億ドル、事業の節目に応じてさらに最大200億ドルをAnthropicに出資
relations.text_en: Amazon agreed to invest $5B in Anthropic now and up to $20B more tied to commercial milestones

source.label: Amazon ニュース
source.quote: Amazon will invest $5 billion in Anthropic today and up to an additional $20 billion in the future tied to certain commercial milestones. This is in addition to the $8 billion Amazon previously invested in Anthropic.
source.note: 追加の200億ドルは事業上の節目の達成が条件です。
source.note_en: The further $20B is contingent on commercial milestones.

relations.text: Trainium2を使う計算クラスター「Project Rainier」を共同で構築
relations.text_en: Built Project Rainier, a Trainium2 compute cluster with nearly half a million chips, in collaboration with Anthropic

source.label: Amazon ニュース
source.quote: AWS collaborated with AI safety and research leader, Anthropic , on Project Rainier, which features nearly half a million Trainium2 chips

relations.text: NVIDIA製チップを使うAWSの計算基盤を、OpenAIが利用できる380億ドルの複数年契約
relations.text_en: $38B multi-year agreement giving OpenAI access to AWS compute built on NVIDIA chips

source.label: Amazon ニュース
source.quote: Under this new $38 billion agreement, which will have continued growth over the next seven years, OpenAI is accessing AWS compute comprising hundreds of thousands of state-of-the-art NVIDIA GPUs

relations.text: AWS Gravitonプロセッサーを大規模に導入する契約
relations.text_en: Agreement to deploy AWS Graviton processors at scale, starting with tens of millions of cores

source.label: Amazon プレスセンター
source.quote: Meta has signed an agreement to deploy AWS Graviton processors at scale.

relations.text: Netflixは計算処理の大半をAWSで動かしている
relations.text_en: Netflix runs the vast majority of its computing on AWS

source.label: Netflix 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Currently, we run the vast majority of our computing on AWS.

relations.text: Palantirは顧客向けの一部の処理を、AWSなどの計算基盤に頼る
relations.text_en: Palantir depends on computing infrastructure operated by AWS and others for some customers

source.label: Palantir 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We depend on computing infrastructure operated by Amazon Web Services (“AWS”), Microsoft, and other third parties

relations.text: ノースアナ原子力発電所の近くで、小型モジュール炉(SMR)の計画を検討する契約
relations.text_en: Agreement to explore an SMR project near the North Anna nuclear station

source.label: Amazon ニュース
source.quote: we’ve signed an agreement with utility company Dominion Energy to explore the development of an SMR project near Dominion’s existing North Anna nuclear power station
source.note: 検討の段階で、建設の約束はありません。
source.note_en: Exploratory; no construction commitment is stated.

relations.text: AIアプリ・データ・AWS Marketplaceでの提供で、AWSとの提携を拡大
relations.text_en: Salesforce and AWS expanded their partnership on AI apps, data and AWS Marketplace availability

source.label: Salesforce の発表
source.quote: Salesforce and AWS Expand Partnership for Customers to More Easily Build Trusted AI Apps

relations.text: Oracleの一部の製品は、競合企業の1社であるAmazonと直接競合する
relations.text_en: Some of Oracle's offerings compete directly with Amazon

source.label: Oracle 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: compete directly with certain offerings from some of the largest and most competitive companies in the world, including Adobe Systems Incorporated, Alphabet Inc., Amazon.com, Inc.

relations.text: AWSは大手クラウドの1社として、Snowflakeと競合する
relations.text_en: AWS, as a large public cloud provider, competes with Snowflake

source.label: Snowflake 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Currently, a substantial majority of our business is run on the AWS public cloud.

relations.text: AWSは、データベース機能を提供するクラウドの1社としてMongoDBと競合している
relations.text_en: AWS competes with MongoDB as a public cloud provider offering database functionality

source.label: MongoDB 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We also compete with public cloud providers such as Amazon Web Services (“AWS”), Google Cloud Platform (“GCP”) and Microsoft Azure that offer database functionality

relations.text: Amazonは、eBayより規模の大きい競合のひとつだ
relations.text_en: Amazon is one of eBay's competitors that are larger than eBay

source.label: eBay 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Some of our competitors, such as Alibaba, Alphabet (Google), Amazon, Apple and Meta (Facebook and Instagram), are larger than we are

relations.text: Amazonは、Costcoの米国での主要な総合小売の競合に含まれる
relations.text_en: Amazon is one of Costco's significant general merchandise retail competitors in the U.S.

source.label: Costco 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Walmart, Target, Kroger, and Amazon are among our significant general merchandise retail competitors in the U.S.

relations.text: Amazon・Best Buy・Walmart・Targetの4社でRokuの端末売上の81%を占め、AmazonはRokuのストリーミング端末の競合でもある
relations.text_en: Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart and Target together account for 81% of Roku's Devices revenue; Amazon is also a streaming-device competitor of Roku

source.label: Roku 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Amazon, Best Buy, Target, and Walmart in total accounted for 81% of our Devices revenue for each of the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024.
source.note: 4社の合計で、Amazon単独の割合は書かれていません。
source.note_en: Combined figure for four retailers; Amazon alone is not stated.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
